entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 9064 K from Kervella et al. (2022), A&A 667, A111, Table 4: Teff of B 9064 +/- 624 K: #d5dfff, because the archives do not resolve this companion from its star. The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 9,064 K and log g 4.28 (u1 0.274, u2 0.316): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
